title: Asymmetric reinforcement learning facilitates human inference of transitive relations.
summary: The primary paper reports an asymmetric reinforcement-learning account of transitive inference and tests the predicted asymmetry in four human experiments (n=145), linking the learned operation to a measured behavioral result. The result-bearing preprint preceded the 2022 journal version.
